summary: Nike reported a first quarter with falling revenue, a full-year outlook calling for a high-single-digit revenue decline, and a new multi-year restructuring program with large charges and promised savings. Margins improved, but the stock already fell about 11% over 21 days and 5% in the latest week, so much of the weak guidance may be priced in. The signals are mixed enough that no clear edge over the S&P 500 stands out.

flags.why: The company guided fiscal 2027 revenue down by a high-single-digit percentage, which is a guidance item that could move the stock.
flags.quote: Revenues are expected to decline high-single digits in fiscal 2027

flags.why: Adjusted EPS guidance was given as a range that excludes restructuring costs, so the earnings picture depends on how the market views the range.
flags.quote: Adjusted Diluted earnings per share** is expected to be in the range of $1.15 to $1.35

flags.why: A multi-year restructuring (Pace) brings sizable charges now against promised long-term savings.
flags.quote: expected to result in pre-tax charges of approximately $1.0 billion

evidence_for.claim: Gross margin expanded 60 basis points to 42.8 percent on lower warehousing and logistics costs.
evidence_for.quote: Gross margin expanded 60 basis points to 42.8 percent, primarily due to lower warehousing and logistics costs.

evidence_for.claim: Management expects the Pace program to deliver approximately $2.5 billion in cumulative savings through fiscal 2031.
evidence_for.quote: The Company expects the program to deliver approximately $2.5 billion in cumulative savings through fiscal 2031.

evidence_against.claim: First quarter revenues were $11.2 billion, down 4 percent reported and down 5 percent currency-neutral.
evidence_against.quote: First quarter revenues were $11.2 billion, down 4 percent on a reported basis and down 5 percent on a currency-neutral basis

evidence_against.claim: Management says actions in Greater China, Sportswear and Jordan will continue to hurt revenues and profitability beyond fiscal 2027.
evidence_against.quote: These actions have adversely affected and are expected to continue to adversely affect, Revenues and overall profitability.

would_change_call: A clear sign that revenue declines are narrowing or that the savings are arriving faster than the charges would move the call toward Bullish, while a further guidance cut would move it toward Bearish.
